verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench with desktop, web and terminal agents, so codebase understanding is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic repository mapping, indexing or whole-codebase explanation without manual context selection. The `--workspace` launch flag and Goal-based planning are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files
